title: Nutritional Sciences, Minor (College of Health and Human Development)

NUTR 495, NUTR 496 max 3cr)' filled with NUTR 400 (needs NUTR 358, prescribed) + NUTR 421 (needs NUTR 251, prescribed); '3cr any NUTR except NUTR 100' filled with NUTR 407 (needs NUTR 251, prescribed).
